detail.longDescription: I published AIPolCom, a dataset of 8D political compass responses from several LLMs. Each model was queried repeatedly, so the data shows both average scores and variation between runs. Open for review and use. What do you think about this data? https:// huggingface.co/datasets/Joosib aeri/aipolcom # AIResearch # AIEthics # DataScience # Politics # KI # Politik
